snippet.title: Hollow Knight on PS VITA ! 9 Minutes of early gameplay
snippet.description:
Upcoming port of game named Hollow Knight that will be coming later this year! 


Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/PatnosD

PayPal: https://paypal.me/PatnosDD

Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/patnosd

Discord: https://discord.gg/WPhjfVt7Rv


Hollow Knight is an epic 2D action-adventure. You’ll explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and escape intricate traps, all to solve an ancient long-hidden mystery.
